name: codex-qa-memory
description: Local-first Codex QA diary and memory toolkit: session-to-diary logger, structured memory nodes, PowerShell CLI, and Codex skills for recall and evidence lookup.

scripts.test: npm run test:python && npm run test:mcp && npm run test:powershell && npm run memory:validate
scripts.test:python: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$env:PYTHONPATH='qa-logger/src'; python -m unittest discover -s qa-logger/tests"
scripts.test:powershell: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File skills/codex-qa-memory/tests/install_core_isolated.ps1 && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File skills/codex-qa-memory/tests/install_task_preflight.ps1 && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File skills/codex-qa-memory/tests/qa_health_isolated_probe.ps1
